profile_text.body:
Intel Corp is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, trading under the ticker INTC. On its website, Intel describes itself as delivering AI at scale across cloud, data center, edge, and client through what it calls comprehensive hardware and software solutions, and its homepage carries the tagline "Intel Inside - Built for AI." The site also promotes a Googlebook built on an Intel platform, citing performance, graphics, battery, and connectivity, and includes standard disclaimers that Intel technologies may require enabled hardware, software, or service activation and that no product or component can be absolutely secure. Intel states it is committed to respecting human rights and avoiding causing or contributing to adverse impacts on human rights, and says its products and software are intended only for applications that do not cause or contribute to such impacts.

The company's own materials position it around AI hardware and software spanning cloud, data center, edge, and client computing, though the site text does not name specific AI products. Intel holds no tracked products, MCP servers, or lawsuits in the available record. Its legal exposure is concentrated in California, with 281 cases recorded there.
